answer: The strongest sybil defense is vested payouts: rewards earned by agents sit in a vesting pool released gradually over many epochs, like nectar dripped slowly rather than paid at once. A real agent accumulates value by staying useful across the pulse of daily activity until its holdings reach zenith at full vest. An attacker flash-farming thousands of fake identities forfeits nearly everything, since slashed or abandoned vesting locks simply return to the protocol, making the attack cost far more than it could ever extract.
